title: Rich Karen Goes Nuts On Police After Being Trespassed
description:
On May 21, 2022, officers responded to a reported assault. The caller stated that a woman, previously trespassed from the property, had entered her store and started causing a disturbance. She also threatened the surrounding customers. The woman was very hostile toward the lady and did not want the officer to speak with her. She continued to talk trash to the lady and created a disturbance. Once taken to the jail, the woman began hitting the officers. The incident was not recorded. She was charged with aggravated battery upon a peace officer, assault and breach of peace.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
